title: Near-Minimax Sample Complexity for Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning under Generative Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.05562v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In multi-objective reinforcement learning, preferences may be specified only after data collection, requiring one dataset to support a continuum of reward trade-offs. We study finite discounted Markov decision processes with unknown transitions, $S$ states, $A$ actions, and $m$ known reward functions taking values in $[0,1]$, given access to a generative model. The learner must provide an $\varepsilon$-optimal policy for every convex combination of these rewards without further sampling, with a guarantee that holds simultaneously over all preferences and initial states. translated_title: 生成模型下多目标强化学习的近极小极大样本复杂度
translated_abstract: 在多目标强化学习中，偏好可能只有在数据收集完成后才能确定，这要求一个数据集能够支持连续的奖励权衡。我们研究了具有未知转移、$S$ 个状态、$A$ 个动作以及 $m$ 个取值于 $[0,1]$ 的已知奖励函数的有限折扣马尔可夫决策过程，并假设学习者可以访问生成模型。学习者必须在不进行进一步采样的情况下，为这些奖励的每一个凸组合提供 $\varepsilon$-最优策略，且该保证需同时适用于所有偏好和初始状态。记 $H=(1-\gamma)^{-1}$，我们建立了常数置信度的极小极大样本复杂度 $\widetilde\Theta\!\left( \frac{SAH^3}{\varepsilon^2}\min\{S,\log(em)\} \right)$，其中被省略的因子是关于 $S,A,H,\varepsilon^{-1}$ 的对数因子，而对 $m$ 的依赖则是显式的。因此，在这些对数因子范围内，支持……
tldr: 本文建立了生成模型下多目标强化学习的常数置信度近极小极大样本复杂度 $\widetilde\Theta\!\left(\frac{SAH^3}{\varepsilon^2}\min\{S,\log(em)\}\right)$，证明单个数据集即可在不进一步采样的情况下同时支持所有奖励凸组合的 $\varepsilon$-最优策略。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes the constant-confidence minimax sample complexity $\widetilde\Theta\!\left(\frac{SAH^3}{\varepsilon^2}\min\{S,\log(em)\}\right)$ for multi-objective RL with a generative model, showing that a single dataset can simultaneously yield $\varepsilon$-optimal policies for all convex combinations of the rewards without further sampling.
